fusions.name: Hoofbeat Loose
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 5 damage, rising to twice that at full reach.

fusions.name: Ride-Down Barrage
fusions.desc: Gallops you to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and looses a ring of arrows around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gallop Clear
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward at a gallop. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Born to the Saddle
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
